user.About: Yo! A cloud wrangler and DevOps Engineer from India turning production chaos into automated poetry. ⚡ Obsessed with CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes clusters, GCP, and all things cloud infrastructure — basically making sure the digital world doesn’t catch fire while you sleep. 🛡️☁️ When I’m not arguing with Terraform manifests or waiting for builds to pass, I’m chasing sunsets for the ‘Gram, calling my blurry pics “aesthetic” 📸, exploring scenic roads, or living on caffeine and good playlists. 🎧🚀 High uptime, zero downtime, and big dreams — let’s build systems that scale. 💫👨‍💻

description: Reviewed and validated pull requests submitted by engineering teams, auditing code and plan outputs against security guardrails before merging to the main branch to ensure zero-drift, reliable GCP deployments.
Provisioned and managed enterprise GCP cloud infrastructure, standardizing project hierarchies, VPC networking, and least-privilege IAM roles.

Served as a core engineer in the Kubernetes squad, managing multi-tenant cluster resources via Terraform to automate namespace provisioning, tune ResourceQuotas/limit ranges, and resolve runtime pod scheduling bottlenecks across GCP environments.
Troubleshot core GCP infrastructure incidents across VPC routing, Compute Engine VMs, and IAM authentication, reducing MTTR by 30%.
Conducted FinOps cost reviews across GCP workloads, eliminating orphaned resources and rightsizing compute to achieve a 20% cloud spend reduction.
Engineered platform automation prototypes including automated pipeline rollbacks, ChatOps bots, and AI-assisted triage tools to eliminate 10+ hours of weekly toil.
Administered enterprise hybrid server fleets across Linux and Windows Server, configuring DNS, DHCP, Active Directory, and Group Policy Objects (GPO).
Maintained high-availability server clusters (Hyper-V, Failover Clustering), resolving critical P1/P2 production incidents with zero downtime.
